name: clearconsent
description: Offline-first dental clinic consent and patient-management app for Dr. Praveen's Dental Clinic. Runs 100% locally on Android phones, 8"+ tablets, or as a local desktop/web app.

scripts.start: npm run build && npx --yes serve public -l 5173
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
